previousRepositoryCitationCheck.rule: Do not use sources already cited by the repository as the evidentiary basis of this review.
excludedExamples: Forecasting Principles and Practice global forecasting summary

sources.title: Distribution-free Calculation of the Standard Error of Chain Ladder Reserve Estimates
sources.useForM2: Treat origin-by-posting-lag maturity as a triangle and publish uncertainty, rather than presenting a point estimate as mature.

sources.title: GEFCom2014 probabilistic electric load forecasting winning solution
sources.useForM2: Combine preprocessing, several forecasts, and residual simulation; evaluate an entire predictive distribution on rolling releases.

sources.title: Probabilistic electric load forecasting: A tutorial review
sources.useForM2: Separate point, quantile, and density forecasts and judge calibration and value by horizon.

sources.title: Booking horizon forecasting with dynamic updating: A case study of hotel reservation data
sources.useForM2: Model the cumulative maturation curve and update remaining revenue when new observations arrive.

sources.title: Empirical validation and comparison of models for customer base analysis
sources.useForM2: Model purchase occurrence and latent inactivity separately; validate against repeat-purchase outcomes instead of treating dormancy as an ordinary regression case.

sources.title: Forecasting with temporal hierarchies
sources.useForM2: Reconcile monthly and multi-month horizons so portfolio forecasts remain temporally coherent.

sources.title: Coherent Probabilistic Forecasts for Hierarchical Time Series
sources.useForM2: Reconcile predictive distributions, not only means, across portfolio and work groupings.

sources.title: Compound Poisson-Gamma Regression Models for Dollar Outcomes That Are Sometimes Zero
sources.useForM2: Represent a zero-or-positive dollar total as a random number of positive monetary events; do not log-transform zeros ad hoc.

sources.title: Making Tweedie's compound Poisson model more accessible
sources.useForM2: Use frequency-severity parameterization when event counts and positive cash amounts are auditable.

sources.title: Forecasting intermittent and sparse time series: A unified probabilistic framework via deep renewal processes
sources.useForM2: Treat time between non-zero events as a stochastic process and compare renewal models to Croston-family baselines.

sources.title: Adaptive Conformal Predictions for Time Series
sources.useForM2: Calibrate intervals sequentially under dependence and distribution shift; ordinary exchangeable conformal claims are not sufficient.

sources.title: Evaluating epidemic forecasts in an interval format
sources.useForM2: Score sharpness and coverage together with a proper weighted interval score and stratify by horizon.

sources.title: Time series cross-validation — tsCV
sources.useForM2: Use rolling forecast origins and only information available at each origin.

sources.title: Comparing Predictive Accuracy, Twenty Years Later: A Personal Perspective on the Use and Abuse of Diebold-Mariano Tests
sources.useForM2: Make claims about historical forecast performance, not universal model superiority, and account for dependent loss differentials.

sources.title: Sequential Monte Carlo Learning for Time Series Structure Discovery
sources.useForM2: Treat interpretable trend, seasonality, and change-point structures as candidates and benchmark them against statistical and neural alternatives.

sources.title: Temporal Fusion Transformers for Interpretable Multi-horizon Time Series Forecasting
sources.useForM2: Reserve global neural models for a later challenger that has trustworthy static and time-varying covariates; architecture alone does not repair missing signals.

sources.title: Deprecation of Node 20 on GitHub Actions runners
sources.useForM2: Keep public Linux and Windows CI actions on a Node 24 runtime so new machines do not inherit an obsolete action runtime.
